review_notes:
The file is one theorem. I read it in full and compared its proof with sibling files that repeat the same proof.

Sibling files compared:
- Cavity/CavityTreeRestrictedAverage.lean (lines 33-49)
- Cavity/CavityRotationRestrictedIntegral.lean (lines 42-63)
- Magnetic/RestrictedTreeRegular.lean (lines 34-50)
- Magnetic/RestrictedTreeAverage.lean
- Magnetic/RestrictedCanonicalLaw.lean (lines 44-64)

The repeated blocks are the `κ`/`f` setup, `hw`, `hf` and `hb`. They are textually identical in these files except for two things: the kernel `ν` and its measurability proof (`cavityRotationProbability` versus `restrictedRotationProbability`), and the name of the tilt parameter (`T` versus `τ`).

I did not check the exact implicit-argument and universe signatures of `cavityHaarSpinPriorKernel`, `cavityWeightedReplicaMean` and `measurable_cavityRegularizedReplicaMean`. The proposed lemma is therefore a sketch and has not been compiled. The end of the proof (the dirac integral and absolute-value bound) is only a two-line wrapper, so I did not count it as repeated machinery.

findings.problem: The block that sets up `ν`, `w`, `κ` and `f` and proves `hw`, `hf` (measurability of the fixed-tree restricted mean) and `hb` (`|f p| ≤ M`) is repeated verbatim in at least five proofs. These are `cavity_restricted_tree_regular` (this file), `cavity_restricted_tree_average`, `cavity_rotation_restricted_integral`, `restricted_tree_regular` and `restricted_canonical_law`, with `RestrictedTreeAverage.lean` matching as well. Only the kernel `ν` and its measurability proof differ (`cavityRotationProbability` versus `restrictedRotationProbability`), plus the tilt name `T`/`τ`. The block does real work: it combines the regularized-replica-mean measurability lemma and its absolute-value bound with the weight-membership lemma, specialised at `δ = 0`, then re-unfolds `cavityRegularizedReplicaMean` with the same `simpa only` list. Any change to the weight, kernel or regularization API must be edited in five or more places.
findings.proposed_change:
Add one lemma next to `cavityHaarRestrictedWeight` or `cavity_bounded_dirac_average` (for example in `CavityRotationRestrictedIntegral.lean`). It is generic in the kernel `ν : (((Orthogonal N × LabeledTree depth) × (ℕ → ℝ))) → Measure (Spin N × LabeledLeaf depth)` with `hν : Measurable ν`, and uses the same hypotheses `e dims E A₀ K L C T B π hM F hF` as the theorem. Its conclusion would be `Measurable f ∧ ∀ p, |f p| ≤ M`, with `f := fun p => cavityWeightedReplicaMean ((ν p.1).prod π) (fun x => cavityHaarRestrictedWeight e (cavityRotationVectors dims E) A₀ K L C T B (p,x)) F`, stated directly in the `(ν p.1).prod π` form the theorems use. The proof is the current `hw`/`hf`/`hb` code, with the `cavityHaarSpinPriorKernel_apply` rewrite folded in.

Then rewrite each user. Here, after `obtain ⟨hf, hb⟩ := cavityHaarRestricted_mean_regular (ν := cavityRotationProbability eig I u) (measurable_cavityRotationProbability eig I u) ...`, the two branches become `measurable_cavity_bounded_dirac_integral μ gaussianCoordinates η _ hf hb` and `abs_integral_le_const_of_bound hf hb`. The Magnetic copy passes `restrictedRotationProbability S hS eig I u` and `measurable_restrictedRotationProbability S hS eig I u`. The averaging, integral and canonical-law proofs pass their `f` into `cavity_bounded_dirac_average` and `cavity_bounded_disorder_shuffle`.
findings.benefit: This removes about 15 near-identical lines from each of the five or more proofs and leaves a single place that justifies measurability and boundedness of the restricted Haar Gibbs mean. The theorem bodies shrink to the part that differs between them. Edits to the weight, kernel or regularization API then touch one lemma instead of five.
